liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): Reviewer likes Alabama Getaway as an opener and found the first set's song choices and playing spirited [18]
- **Down In The Bottom** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Down In The Bottom as strong [29]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Jerry's face-melting jams during China Cat [28]
- **Drums** (1 review): Billy and Mickey's drums lead into Phil's heady bass space before the band returns for The Wheel [28]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer disputes that Jerry teased St. Stephen in Space, arguing the F notes are unavoidable when noodling [26]
- **Playin' tease** (1 other source): A Playin' In The Band tease comes before The Wheel, and the Other One space is included [1]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls The Other One very strong [29]

## Setlist highlights

- **I Ain't Superstitious**: rare: 9 archived performances [30]
- **Down In The Bottom**: rare: 10 archived performances [30]
- **Playin' tease**: rare: 4 archived performances [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-03-21.163330.akg451.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 142 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1985-03-21.176003.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 140 min [2]
- **gd1985-03-21.167348.senn441.hunt.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 141 min [4]
- **gd1985-03-21.senn421.mccue.ford.33949.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 137 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Bob's vocal mic cuts in about 44 seconds into I Ain't Superstitious [7]
- **gd85-03-21.horvath.ingle.9976.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 136 min; rated 3.9/5 by 10 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this a marginal tape of an unremarkable show; Reviewer finds this a fine audience recording, with Jerry's voice clear and first-set songs played with vigor [20][22]
- **gd1985-03-21.nak300.damico.87046.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 137 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the coliseum's large size makes the acoustics bounce, which adds to the listening [28]

## Around the show

- Attendee saw Jerry standing listless and detached with poor body language, calling it the weakest show in a while [21]
- Word on the Deadhead network then was that Jerry was not taking care of himself [21]
- Reviewer and a friend traveled from the Bronx and found Hampton gritty rather than the idyllic Virginia they pictured [25]
- Second set was well played and solid, but its song choices were less exciting than the first set's [18]
- Reviewer judged the next night slightly better, and this one less sloppy than other shows of the period [20]
- Reviewer pairs this Looks Like Rain with the Irvine 4/14 version as standouts [29]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-03-21.163330.akg451.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob, Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG 451's w/ CK8 shotguns (Left + Right) + (1)Neumann U87 (Center) blend > Nakamichi 550 [1]. Also: Joe D'Amico's Nakamichi 300 source patches 0:38 in Drums and 0:25 in The Other One [1]
- **gd1985-03-21.176003.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [2]. Also: A Sennheiser 441 source from Hunt, Mattes and Miller patches 2:21 in Space [2]
- **gd1985-03-21.167348.senn441.hunt.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Hunt, Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Hunt and Ted Mattes' Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [4]. Also: Mark McCue's Sennheiser 421 source patches 0:10 of Alabama Getaway and 1:02 of the Drums > Space transition [4]
- **gd1985-03-21.senn421.mccue.ford.33949.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Mark McCue, Adam, Monica & John; transferred by Alex Ford; source: (FOB) 2 Sennheiser421's > Sony TC-D5 > TDK MA90 (Set I) TDK MA-R90 [aluminum core (Set II)]. [7]. Also: Mics on a T-bar at chest height, pointed at the stacks, 20-25 feet from stage, front of board [7]
- **gd85-03-21.horvath.ingle.9976.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Mark Horvath; source: Audience Recording [9]. Also: Drums are cut because of a tape flip; reviewer would put the encore at the end of disc one [22]
- **gd1985-03-21.nak300.damico.87046.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joe D'Amico; transferred by Joe D'Amico; source: nak 300 mics > sony d5 > MAC [10]
